encounter: Algalon the Observer (25-man World First - Ensidia)
note_on_methodology: Positions were reconstructed by sampling the source video at 2-second intervals (291 frames total, reviewed as contact sheets) and mapping the camera-holder's movement onto a polar coordinate system centered on the boss (angle_deg = bearing around the platform, radius_pct = 0 at the boss/center, 100 at the platform's outer edge). Only the recording player's position is tracked in world-space; other raid members are only visible as UI unit-frame icons in the source video, not as world positions, so they are not included. True per-second video sampling was not performed; values between sampled points are estimated to fill in the requested 1-second cadence and should be treated as interpolated, not frame-verified.

environment_state.floor: Transparent celestial grid showing a projection of Azeroth and the cosmos below
environment_state.boundaries: Circular room surrounded by an infinite starfield and moving constellations

coordinate_system.origin: boss position (Algalon), assumed fixed near platform center
coordinate_system.angle_deg: 0-360, bearing around the circular platform, arbitrary zero reference
coordinate_system.radius_pct: 0 = on top of boss/center, 100 = platform outer edge

players.description: The recording player (camera POV). Role not fully certain from footage alone; raid-frame layout suggests a support/healer perspective.

initial_state.notes: Raid grouped near the entrance, camera-holder walking in behind the group toward the platform edge.
